The '''Southern Core''' was a region of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] within [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] that grew as an extension of the [[Arrowhead]] in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core]] and [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]].

It included [[Balosar/Legends|Balosar]], [[Daupherm Planet States]], [[Fondor/Legends|Fondor]], and [[Herglic Space/Legends|Herglic Space]].

==Behind the scenes==
''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' clearly identified the Inner Core as the [[Arrowhead]]. However, in endnotes for ''The Essential Atlas'', [[Jason Fry]] identified the Inner Core as the Southern Core.
